sources.title: Math 108: Discrete Mathematics independent original course identity and semester quantity
sources.reviewedExtract:
Online Discrete Math Course for College Credit
3 lower level credits
Earn 3 transferable credits in our ACE-recommended Discrete Mathematics course (SDCM-0210), the math foundation of CS.
Study.com's Discrete Mathematics course (Math 108) is an online, self-paced way to earn college credit. It's ACE-recommended for 3 transferable semester hours (ACE Course ID: SDCM-0210).
Credits: 3 transferable, lower-division semester hours, recommended by ACE (Course ID: SDCM-0210)
Passing grade: 70% or higher on your final course grade (chapter tests count for two-thirds, the final exam for one-third)
Prerequisites: No prerequisites required for this course
